## How this works

1. Replace `example text` in the **title** above with anything you like. Anything works: a sentence start, a question, a line of code.
2. Click **Submit new issue**.
3. A GitHub Action runs the model and **the animation at the top of the profile changes to show the answer**. The bot also replies here and closes this issue (about 3 to 5 minutes).

You can leave this box as is. Only the title is read.
